edge.title: Replace Muon with PSGD Kron whitening + hyperball step
edge.summary: Hidden matrices are trained with PSGD-Kron: a bias-corrected momentum m̂ (beta 0.95) is preconditioned as (Q0ᵀQ0)·m̂·(Q1ᵀQ1), where upper-triangular Kronecker factors Q0 (rows) and Q1 (cols) are fitted every step by a spectrally-normalized Lie-group gradient step (precond_lr 1.0) that whitens m̂ against a Gaussian probe. The direction goes through a hyperball step (norm preserved, no weight decay), and the hidden matrices are re-drawn Gaussian with the hyperball family's ×1.25/×3.0/×1.5 multipliers; nothing is zeroed, so the LM head and biases keep PyTorch's default init. PSGD lr 0.025 decays linearly from step 0 while aux AdamW decays linearly to 0.1× over the second half; the loss is now mean-reduced, and the record is the step-3375 eval of 3400-step runs.

changes.label: PSGD Kron whitening preconditioner
changes.detail: PSGDKron.step: exp_avg.lerp_(g, 0.05), m̂ = exp_avg/(1 − 0.95^t); psgd_update_precond fits Q0, Q1 (init s·I, s = mean(|g|⁴)^(−1/32)) from A = Q0 m̂ Q1ᵀ and B = Q0⁻ᵀ v Q1⁻¹ (v ~ N(0,1)) via Q ← Q − (1/‖AAᵀ+BBᵀ‖₂)·triu(AAᵀ − BBᵀ)·Q; direction (Q0ᵀQ0) m̂ (Q1ᵀQ1).

changes.label: Hyperball step (inline)
changes.detail: new_p = p − lr·u·‖p‖/(‖u‖ + 1e-10); p ← new_p·‖p‖/(‖new_p‖ + 1e-10): the #4/#5 rule written inline with additive eps; Muon's weight decay 0.01 is gone.

changes.label: Gaussian per-module init, no zeroing
changes.detail: Block matrices are re-drawn N(0, std²), std = (1/√(3·fan_in))·{mlp.proj 3.0, mlp.fc 1.5, attn.proj 1.25, q/k/v 1.0}; nothing is zeroed, so the LM head and all biases keep PyTorch defaults (#1 zeroed every 'proj' parameter).

changes.label: Mean-reduced loss, averaged grads
changes.detail: cross_entropy reduction 'mean', micro-batch losses divided by num_mbs and grads all_reduce AVG (was sum/SUM), shrinking gradients by the 524,288-token batch; PSGD + hyperball are scale-free, so this mainly shifts AdamW's eps = 1e-10 relative to √v.

changes.label: Separate PSGD / AdamW schedules
changes.detail: get_psgd_lr = 0.025·(1 − step/3400) from step 0 (cooldown_frac 1.0, no warmup); get_adam_lr_scale = 1 until step 1700, then linear to 0.1 at 3400 (was one shared 0.7 cooldown to 0).

changes.label: 3400 steps scheduled, 3375 claimed
changes.detail: train_steps = 3400; the record uses the step-3375 validation from the same runs (README's own check was at 3400).

changes.label: Skeleton tweaks
changes.detail: RMSNorm/QK-norm via F.rms_norm (as in the updated baseline), comments stripped, AdamW referenced as torch.optim.AdamW, padded all_gather loop over len(params_pad), val-loss averaging rewritten for the mean reduction.

hparams_changed.label: proj init
hparams_changed.to: nothing zeroed; LM head default init

edge.parent_check: Inferred parent #1 is the closest script (261 changed lines) and supplies the skeleton, but this is a rewrite that borrows from the hyperball family (#4/#5: the norm-preserving step, the ×1.25/×3.0/×1.5 init multipliers, hidden lr decaying from step 0) and from the updated baseline (F.rms_norm RMSNorm); #5 is a reasonable influence.
edge.noise: Comment stripping, the AdamW import change, the F.rms_norm rewrite of RMSNorm/QK-norm, the extra (padding-only) all_gather iteration and the rewritten val-loss averaging.

mechanisms.name: PSGD Kron whitening preconditioner
mechanisms.explain: Each hidden matrix has upper-triangular factors Q0 (m×m) and Q1 (n×n), giving P = (Q0ᵀQ0) ⊗ (Q1ᵀQ1). Every step, with A = Q0 m̂ Q1ᵀ and a probe B = Q0⁻ᵀ v Q1⁻¹, each factor takes a multiplicative step Q ← Q − (precond_lr/‖AAᵀ+BBᵀ‖₂)·triu(AAᵀ − BBᵀ)·Q (spectral norm from 1.5 power iterations) after rebalancing the factors' max-abs values, which drives P toward whitening the momentum. The step direction is P applied to m̂, then normalized by the hyperball update.

mechanisms.name: Hyperball step (inline)
mechanisms.explain: The PSGD direction is rescaled to Frobenius norm lr·‖W‖ (factor p_norm/(u_norm + 1e-10)), subtracted, and W is rescaled back to its previous norm — the #4/#5 rule written inline with additive eps. With no weight decay, each block matrix keeps its initial norm for the whole run and lr acts as a relative (angular) step.

mechanisms.name: Per-module Gaussian init
mechanisms.explain: Block matrices are re-drawn from N(0, (k/√(3·fan_in))²) with k = 3.0 for mlp.proj, 1.5 for mlp.fc, 1.25 for attn.proj and 1 for q/k/v — the same stds as #4/#5's scaled uniform init. Because the hyperball freezes norms, these fix the radii (expected ≈16/20/48).

mechanisms.name: Separate PSGD / AdamW schedules
mechanisms.explain: The PSGD lr (get_psgd_lr) decays linearly from 0.025 at step 0 to 0 at step 3400. AdamW (get_adam_lr_scale) stays at full LR until step 1700, then decays linearly to 0.1× of its base LR at 3400, so the aux params never anneal to 0.

mechanisms.name: Early stop before schedule end
mechanisms.explain: Runs are scheduled for 3400 steps, but the record is the step-3375 validation from the same logs (25 steps early). There the PSGD lr is ≈0.8% of peak and AdamW is at ≈0.11× of base.

caveats: The README validates at 3400 steps (mean 3.27666) and notes the count could drop by 20+; the table's 3375 is the step-3375 eval in the same five logs (mean 3.27791). The switch to mean-reduced loss / AVG gradients is an unablated side change that matters mainly to AdamW through eps. The PSGD init scale exponent (−1/32 per factor) is copied from code; README pseudocode does not specify it.
